notes: Machine-readable tool registry. The docarbiter skill routes by category; this file is the source of truth for what exists. The harnesses section is the source of truth for skill directories and install shapes; install.sh and doctor.sh read it. Adding a tool in an existing category requires one entry here plus an optional thin shell in skills/_tools/.

harnesses.label: agents
harnesses.note: shared global root; MiniMax Code needs a whole-directory symlink and a new session

harnesses.label: codex
harnesses.note: real SKILL.md copy; 600+ skills can hide descriptions; explicit call or minimal set

harnesses.label: minimax
harnesses.note: MiniMax Code does not scan this directory; use .agents/skills

tools.name: MinerU
tools.best_for: Chinese or English PDF that needs clean paragraphs, heading levels, and page anchors; scanned or garbled text-layer tables
tools.avoid_when: You only need a fast text preview; the input is Office, audio, or video; a clean text layer with complex merged/multi-line cells (Docling preserves cell reading order better)

tools.name: Docling
tools.best_for: Office and mixed formats, RAG chunks, LaTeX, non-PDF inputs, and complex text-layer tables with merged headers or multi-line cells
tools.avoid_when: You only need to read PDF body text quickly; Chinese borderless tables (Docling may return 0 tables; try pdfplumber text strategy)

tools.name: liteparse
tools.best_for: Fast reading of a PDF with a usable text layer; word-level coordinates and font metadata
tools.avoid_when: Scanned PDF; you need clean paragraphs and stable heading levels for a manuscript

tools.name: MarkItDown
tools.best_for: Simple single-column Office or PDF files
tools.avoid_when: Scanned PDF; complex tables; two-column reading order is unverified (a synthetic interleaved test did not reproduce the failure)

tools.name: RapidOCR
tools.best_for: Single image, screenshot, or page OCR with Chinese text
tools.avoid_when: Whole scanned PDF (render pages first); you need layout and reading order

tools.name: OCRmyPDF
tools.best_for: Turning a scanned PDF into a searchable PDF before structured extraction
tools.avoid_when: The PDF already has a usable text layer; the input is a single image
tools.install: pip install ocrmypdf==17.12.1  # plus tesseract + chi_sim

tools.name: pdfplumber
tools.best_for: Simple bordered grids and character-level coordinates on a text-layer PDF
tools.avoid_when: Scanned PDF; merged headers or multi-line cells in real book/standard tables (text order scrambles; use Docling); borderless tables (0 tables found by default; text strategy can recover but hurts merged cells); interleaved two-column reading order (60–68% CER in the synthetic edge test)

tools.name: pdftotext (Poppler)
tools.best_for: Plain-text baseline, text-layer probing, fast retrieval
tools.avoid_when: You need structure, tables, or OCR; the text layer is CID-damaged
tools.install: brew install poppler  # or apt install poppler-utils

tools.name: PaddleOCR
tools.best_for: Chinese OCR and PP-Structure layout/table analysis
tools.avoid_when: You want a lightweight install; no GPU/CPU budget

tools.name: Marker
tools.best_for: High-quality PDF-to-Markdown with a GPU; multilingual layouts
tools.avoid_when: No GPU and a large document; you need the fastest text-layer read

tools.name: Unstructured
tools.best_for: Batch, multi-format ingestion into element-level records
tools.avoid_when: A single small file; the environment cannot take a heavy dependency tree

tools.name: olmOCR
tools.best_for: Hard scanned documents with a GPU; complex layouts
tools.avoid_when: No GPU; a lightweight or offline-only setup; a born-digital PDF

tools.name: Surya
tools.best_for: OCR/layout/reading-order building blocks; Marker's underlying models
tools.avoid_when: You want a one-command document converter

tools.name: Camelot
tools.best_for: Text-layer tables with lattice/stream strategies; complements pdfplumber
tools.avoid_when: Scanned PDF; you need full-document layout

tools.name: Tesseract
tools.best_for: Universal OCR fallback; already required by OCRmyPDF
tools.avoid_when: Chinese accuracy matters; PaddleOCR/RapidOCR are better

tools.name: qpdf
tools.avoid_when: You need text, tables, or OCR

tools.name: pdfminer.six
tools.best_for: Low-level text/coordinate extraction when pdfplumber is too high-level
tools.avoid_when: You need layout, tables, or OCR
